queries.name: ui_lite.display_status
queries.purpose: Read the cached front-panel status, error selections, digit values, wireless/button/LED flags.
queries.control_flow_proof: A044DDDA copies48bytes of status20DEFE04 throughA0453960, and optionally formats up to16active error slots. A04539C6 tests a bit in the cached word20DEFE2C. A0450338 reads cached displaydigits20DEF73C/740. A044FE6A copies12bytes20DEF044. TailA044E08C copies28bytes20DEFDE8 viaA0453326 and prints byteflags. All three copy helpers tail throughA03E47C4, an ARM veneer to ITCM000006BC, the reviewed bounded memmove. No UI refresh/setter, GPIO, illumination or state-machine dispatch is called. All loop bounds and stack destinations are fixed.
queries.side_effects: UART output, local stack buffers and parser state only.
queries.interpretation: Cached UI state; no physical panel changes or refresh request. Concurrent firmware tasks may change fields during the query.
